name: Optimize CodeViewer diff rendering performance
description:
## Summary

1. **Issue Identified**: CodeViewer was using Monaco's heavy DiffEditor for diff mode, causing performance degradation when rendering large diffs.

2. **Solution Proposed**: Replace Monaco DiffEditor with the lightweight `@git-diff-view/vue` component already used in PRChanges for better performance.

3. **Implementation**: Updated CodeViewer imports to include DiffViewer component and added @git-diff-view/vue CSS styles.

4. **Template Changes**: Swapped the Monaco diff editor with the lightweight DiffViewer component while preserving edit mode (Monaco single-side) and read-only view functionality.

5. **Result**: Maintains all diff editing capabilities with significantly improved app performance by eliminating the heavy editor overhead from diff viewing operations.
